messages:
Alex: Kicking off a canary shift to model:redwood-70b-q4_0 — auto-rollback fired immediately. rollout-controller reverted to stable.
ops-bot: [automated-rollback] rollout/redwood-model-canary reverted at 2024-11-05T14:02Z due to policy:scale-rate-limit :warning:
Maria: Confirming. New canary pods are Pending on gpu-pool-a; cluster-autoscaler hit provider rate limits when allocating GPUs.
Chris: I think there's terraform drift on the nodepool autoscaling config. The TF desiredSize change wasn't applied; cloud quota is untouched in prod workspace.
Lee: Can someone paste the pod describe? I saw a CrashLoop related to driver init earlier.
Alex: Pasted describe + events:
```
kubectl describe pod redwood-canary-0
Events:
  Warning  FailedScheduling  2s  default-scheduler  0/10 nodes are available: 3 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu, 7 node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate
```
Maria: That taint came from last week's maintenance; repo removed the taint but the gitops sync didn't apply because ArgoCD detected a helm override.
Chris: Also found helm values drift: canary.weight in values.yaml set to 30 in repo but ArgoCD shows 70 due to a sync-hook bug. So traffic shifted too quickly while autoscaler was limited.
Lee: Short-term plan: pin canary weight to 10, pause rollout, and manually scale nodepool by +2. Long-term: prevent drift and add preflight checks.
Alex: I've patched the HelmRelease via ArgoCD UI to weight: 10 and paused the rollout. Opening a TF apply PR to reconcile node taints and autoscaler policy now.
Maria: We should add a gitops preflight check that queries cloud quota and fails pipeline if insufficient GPUs for intended canary weight.
Chris: I'll add a GitLab CI job: run `gcloud compute quotas describe --project=$PROJ` (or provider equivalent) and compute required GPUs for target weight; fail if quota < required.
Lee: Also recommend adding rollout.policy.rateLimit and maxSurge in the canary spec so controller never flips >X% in Y mins.
Alex: Agreed. I'll create an RFC for rollout policy defaults and a checklist for canary flips that includes quota validation and taint checks.
ops-bot: Action items: 1) TF PR #4321 opened to reconcile nodepool config; 2) manual scale requested in console; 3) incident created if issues persist. See /runbooks/canary-rollback
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-3112, severity: low, linked PR: #4321
Maria: Long term: add an automated dry-schedule preflight in CI that does `kubectl create --dry-run=client` + scheduler simulator to ensure N pods can schedule.
Chris: I'll prototype the scheduler dry-run job and a small e2e that validates N scheduling slots in a staging cluster.
Lee: Leaving notes on the incident board and handing to oncall in 15m. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
